# VI skill list fixtures

These 505 × 480 crops contain only the Skills → VI "6th Job" header, skill rows, and
scrollbar, with no character names, chat, or surrounding game scene.
`vi_top.png` and `vi_bottom.png` are both ends of a scrolled HEXA-class list.
The bottom capture starts part-way through a row. `erel.png` is an Erel Light list
that fits without scrolling. Tests place them on blank 1366 × 768 client canvases
and simulate the 1440p filtered stretch.

`readings.json` records actual PP-OCRv6 skill-name results, keyed by crop shape and
SHA-256. Levels are read from the digit glyphs in `images/window/scouter/vi_digits.png`.
